brandPositioningSummary: EVEN Hotels is a wellness-led upscale select / lifestyle hotel brand within IHG Hotels & Resorts. For owners, the affiliation case is wellness positioning, conversion or new-build prototype fit, IHG distribution and loyalty, operating model implications, and market demand for wellness-minded travelers. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among Holiday Inn Express, avid hotels, voco, Hotel Indigo.
ownerFitSummary: wellness positioning, conversion or new-build prototype fit, IHG distribution and loyalty, operating model implications, and market demand for wellness-minded travelers
propertyFitSummary: urban and gateway hotels where wellness, fitness, nutrition, and productivity cues are commercially relevant and can be delivered consistently

scenarios.title: Wellness-led urban conversion
scenarios.summary: An urban or gateway hotel where owners want a clearer wellness identity without moving into a soft-collection or boutique soft brand. EVEN is worth evaluating when fitness, nutrition, rest, and productivity cues can be delivered in rooms and public space, and when IHG distribution can support the intended guest mix.

scenarios.title: New-build wellness prototype
scenarios.summary: A new-build opportunity in a market with wellness-minded business and bleisure demand. EVEN can fit when the owner can underwrite the brand’s wellness product cues, operating rhythm, and IHG systems participation, rather than treating wellness as marketing-only language. Owners should diligence whether EVEN Hotels is a better fit than Holiday Inn Express for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Repositioning from generic upscale select
scenarios.summary: A hotel that competes in upscale select but lacks a distinctive guest promise. EVEN may help when the asset can support wellness-forward rooms and public spaces and the owner wants IHG platform reach without choosing Holiday Inn Express or avid’s essentials lane. Owners should diligence whether EVEN Hotels is a better fit than Holiday Inn Express for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.
